inputs.label: Duke Nukem 3D
inputs.help: Your installed copy of Duke Nukem 3D. qgp copies duke3d.grp.

inputs.label: Blood (optional)
inputs.help: Your installed copy of Blood. qgp copies blood.rff and the sound files.

inputs.label: Shadow Warrior (optional)
inputs.help: Your installed copy of Shadow Warrior. qgp copies sw.grp.

steps.why: The first launch creates a subfolder for each supported game in /sdcard/RazeXR/.

steps.text: Open RazeXR from Library > Unknown Sources and choose your game in the launcher menu.

notes: Steam app IDs come from the payload's store links (Duke Nukem 3D 20th Anniversary World Tour, Blood: Fresh Supply, Shadow Warrior Classic Redux); where those editions keep duke3d.grp, blood.rff and sw.grp is not checked, and the names may be upper case. Blood also needs "all sound files"; the guide does not name them, so *.rff is a guess. The payload says files may also go directly in /sdcard/RazeXR/. The release also has razexrlauncher_oculus.apk, which the guide does not mention; it is not installed. Duke Nukem 3D is treated as required because the payload marks it as the base game.
